shared_elements: upright rectangular slab/monument bearing carved decoration
dense field of script-like signs arranged in ordered rows/columns
signs enclosed within a framed or bordered rectangular field
low-relief carved signs including human-face/head motifs
division of the field into repeated compartments
justification: Both surfaces are upright framed slabs whose whole face is filled with ordered, compartmentalised script signs carved in low relief, which is a real but broad correspondence. They differ in nearly everything specific: A is exclusively two tall vertical columns of dense square sign-blocks with no scene, while B combines a single horizontal text band with a winged/eye emblem above and several registers of profile human figures kneeling, standing and presenting offerings.
